requirements: Require every exact registered label once in the complete real AUnit capture, zero failures/unexpected errors, matching source/runtime identity and physical shutdown provenance.

Five statement-condition regressions execute actual Ada Session programs and require the same focused lifetime observations; their native Lua counterparts are separately source-bound. They supplement real public C calls and cannot certify a C export independently.
Source registration, assertion bodies and direct underlying C selector must remain bound to their actual current bytes.
successor_review_requirement: Review changed source semantics and all named witness routes independently; fresh source hashes alone grant no execution or coverage authority.
